name: cortex
description: Cortex, the MCP second brain, in Claude Code: a light above the prompt shows whether your brain is on (green), off or unreachable (red); cortex:me saves something to your own personal layer ("remember …"), which you approve yourself; cortex:share proposes something for the shared memory (NEOCORTEX), which an admin decides on. Needs the Cortex MCP server connected.
